decisions.reason: The framing progression applies to the three character-image pairs, not the separate deferred opening aerial establishing shot.
The wide-to-mid-to-closer framing order does not alter the requirement that sets remain stylistically consistent across shots.
The source clarifies a specific character-pair framing order but does not change the revised script as the governing content source.
The prescribed framing sequence does not change the existing permissions to adjust shot angles or generate new set images when needed for image quality.
